title: Path.copy fails on filesystems where FICLONE returns EPERM instead of falling back
author: dropps07
body_preview: Path.copy() on Linux tries FICLONE first. On filesystems where that ioctl is blocked it returns EPERM (e.g. overlayfs in containers; SELinux-blocked ioctl is a known precedent). pathlib/_os.py copyfileobj only falls back on EBADF, EOPNOTSUPP, ETXTBSY, EXDEV, so the copy fails with PermissionError even though a regular copy works — shutil.copy() succeeds on the same files. title: Return types in tkinter.filedialog
author: Akuli
body_preview: If I cancel or close the dialog without selecting anything, I get:  ``` >>> import tkinter.filedialog >>> tkinter.filedialog.askdirectory() () >>>  ```  The stub says that the return type is `str`. We should probably use `str | tuple[()]` to also allow empty tuples. The actual type may also depend on the Tcl/Tk version.  I haven't tried other `tkinter.filedialog` functions.
